BiblicalUsage: The tear appears once, in the law of the firstfruits: the first of your ripe fruits you shall bring to the house of the Lord. The tear is the juice of the grape, the first drop of the harvest, and it belongs to God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the first tear of the harvest is the confession that the whole vintage is His.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
